standard_prerequisites.name: Uniqueness of left duals
standard_prerequisites.use: Left duals are unique up to unique isomorphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: Module-level left duals
standard_prerequisites.use: F^n is locally a direct summand of a finite free module.

core_obligations: By uniqueness of left duals (Categories, Remark left-dual-adjoint) it suffices to show F^• is locally bounded with locally projective summand terms (proof lines 12850-12853).

Decompose η = Ση_n and ε = Σε_n; from (1 ⊗ ε)∘(η ⊗ 1) = id and (ε ⊗ 1)∘(1 ⊗ η) = id the per-degree identities (1 ⊗ ε_n)∘(η_n ⊗ 1) = id_{F^n} and (ε_n ⊗ 1)∘(1 ⊗ η_n) = id_{G^{-n}} hold (proof lines 12854-12864).
By Modules, Lemma left-dual-module each F^n is locally a direct summand of a finite free O_X-module; since Ση_n is locally finite, F^• is locally bounded (proof lines 12865-12875).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the per-degree duality identities.
Local boundedness from local finiteness of the unit.
difficulty_reason: Uniqueness of left duals gives the final statement; the duality identities decompose into per-degree identities which the module-level left-dual lemma converts into local summands of finite free, and local finiteness of the unit gives local boundedness.
